title: Rav Chiyya son of Rav Yeiva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sukkah 42b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.42b.2), adding to Rav Chisda’s words and saying, “And an adult, even though he is not able — as it is written, ‘He who increases knowledge,’” etc. Hyman reports that [the Rif](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Sukkah.20b.4) reads Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba and that Dikdukei Soferim reads “son of Ravina.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rav Chiyya son of Rav Yeiva. The Rif gives a fuller reading: Rav Chiyya bar Abba, son of Rav Avya. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1283&lang=en) also records the fuller Rif reading. Hyman attributes “son of Ravina” to Dikdukei Soferim.
